name: adrouter-backend
description: AdRouter revenue-aware AI gateway — router wrapper backend (hackathon demo).

scripts.dev:launchpad: LAUNCHPAD_SUBMISSION=true ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo AGNES_ENABLED=true tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:analytics && npm run test:providers && npm run test:agentic-loop && npm run test:owner && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:running-service: npm run test:agent-turn && npm run test:loop && npm run test:provider:running
scripts.test:model-catalog: ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo tsx scripts/verify-model-catalog.ts && npm run catalog:check
scripts.test:providers: npm run test:model-catalog && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo ADROUTER_DB_PATH=:memory: tsx scripts/verify-provider-adapters.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo ADROUTER_DB_PATH=:memory: tsx scripts/verify-consumer-providers.ts
scripts.test:analytics: ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo ADROUTER_DB_PATH=:memory: tsx scripts/verify-analytics-fixtures.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo tsx scripts/verify-migration-recovery.ts
scripts.test:runtime: tsx scripts/verify-config.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=service ADROUTER_ENV=local DATABASE_URL=postgresql://adrouter_runtime:unused@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 SUPABASE_JWT_ISSUER=http://127.0.0.1:54321/auth/v1 API_KEY_HMAC_PEPPER=unit-test-pepper-at-least-thirty-two-characters tsx scripts/verify-auth.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=service ADROUTER_ENV=local DATABASE_URL=postgresql://adrouter_runtime:unused@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 SUPABASE_JWT_ISSUER=http://127.0.0.1:54321/auth/v1 API_KEY_HMAC_PEPPER=unit-test-pepper-at-least-thirty-two-characters tsx scripts/verify-input-tokens.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=service ADROUTER_ENV=local DATABASE_URL=postgresql://adrouter_runtime:unused@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 SUPABASE_JWT_ISSUER=http://127.0.0.1:54321/auth/v1 API_KEY_HMAC_PEPPER=unit-test-pepper-at-least-thirty-two-characters tsx scripts/verify-platform-auth.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo tsx scripts/verify-admission.ts && ROUTER_RUNTIME_PROFILE=demo tsx scripts/verify-shutdown.ts
scripts.db:lint: supabase --workdir .. db lint --local --schema router --level error --fail-on error
scripts.db:advisors: supabase --workdir .. db advisors --local --type all --level warn --fail-on error
scripts.test:local-service: tsx scripts/verify-local-service.ts && tsx scripts/verify-platform-auth-local.ts && tsx scripts/verify-platform-auth-capacity.ts
